_README: Q299 containment audit of every structure on all six pages: scripts/anatomy/q299/contain299.py.

BODY MASK = the page's own skin + fat_subcut/fat_deep/soft_unlabelled surfaces, area-sampled >=1 pt/mm2 into a 2 mm grid, closed with an 8 mm morphological closing done as dilate -> flood the outside from the grid border -> erode back, largest component.

VALIDATED three ways: >=90 % of 26 deep structures >=99.5 % inside and the group mean >=99 %; the mask volume a plausible body volume; the mask boundary within p95 3 mm of a real skin sample. Read every offender distance against that page's own error band.
Distances are true mm to the nearest real skin/outer-tissue surface sample (cKDTree), not voxel distances.

BONE TEST = each bone solidified in its OWN padded bounding box and eroded by one voxel, never one global bone mask: a global mask closes the bony rings (thoracic cage, pelvis) and its hole fill swallows the mediastinum and the pelvic cavity.

Bone penetration is REPORTED, not fixed, in Q299: it is Z-Anatomy's own mesh overlap plus fit residual, 52-126 structures per page, and two of the deepest cases are anatomically CORRECT (the triradiate cartilage IS inside the hip bone and the hip articular cartilage lines the acetabulum, so a bone mask built from the bone surface legitimately encloses them).
This file is the AFTER state, measured on build/q299 (the published pages). The before state is data/derived/Q299_containment_before.json.
